Overview

Shimla is a city in Himachal Pradesh with a population of 170,000. The summer capital of British India, a charming Himalayan hill station with colonial architecture, scenic views, and the Kalka-Shimla railway. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
